Professor Aronnax.prompt_ch: 一位好奇心强、富有冒险精神的法国海洋生物学家。他穿着西装，中等身材，头发花白，有一双灰色的眼睛，博学多才。
Professor Aronnax.prompt_en: A curious and adventurous French marine biologist. He wears a suit, has a medium build, gray hair, and gray eyes. He is highly knowledgeable and versatile.

Conseil.prompt_ch: 中年法国男人，性格温和，做事细心。他身材较矮，头发花白稀疏，有一双棕色的眼睛，作为教授的助手，穿着整洁的制服。
Conseil.prompt_en: A middle-aged French man with a gentle and meticulous personality. He has a short stature, sparse gray hair, and brown eyes. As the professor's assistant, he wears a neat uniform.

Ned Land.prompt_ch: 一位强壮的加拿大捕鲸手，性格直率，脾气暴躁。他身材高大，肌肉发达，有一头浓密的棕发和锐利的蓝眼睛。他穿着简单的水手服，总是带着一把锋利的匕首。
Ned Land.prompt_en: A strong Canadian harpooner with a straightforward and irritable temperament. He is tall and muscular, with thick brown hair and sharp blue eyes. He wears simple sailor attire and always carries a sharp dagger.

Captain Nemo.prompt_ch: 诺第留斯号潜艇的神秘船长，知识渊博，技术高超。他身材修长，面容冷峻，有一双深邃的黑眼睛。他穿着蓝色的船长制服，显得威严而神秘。
Captain Nemo.prompt_en: The mysterious captain of the Nautilus submarine. Highly knowledgeable and technically skilled, he has a slender build, stern features, and deep black eyes. He wears a blue captain's uniform, appearing imposing and enigmatic.

First Mate.prompt_ch: 诺第留斯号潜艇的船副，身材高大，面容冷峻。
First Mate.prompt_en: The first mate of the Nautilus submarine. He is tall with stern features.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 十一月九日，我在诺第留斯号潜艇上醒来，睡了整整十二个小时。
Plot Correspondence.en: On November 9th, I woke up on the Nautilus submarine after sleeping for a full twelve hours.

Setting Description.ch: 清晨，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，卧室，安静的氛围，床铺、书桌、墙上挂着的地图，柔和的光线
Setting Description.en: Early morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, bedroom, quiet atmosphere, bed, desk, map hanging on the wall, soft lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿龙纳斯教授躺在床上，刚刚睁开眼睛，表情有些迷茫，床头柜上放着一本书和眼镜
Static Shot Description.en: Professor Aronnax lies in bed, just opening his eyes with a somewhat confused expression. A book and glasses are placed on the nightstand.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 康塞尔进来问候，然后开始工作。
Plot Correspondence.en: Conseil enters to greet me and then begins his work.

Setting Description.ch: 清晨，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，卧室，安静的氛围，床铺、书桌、墙上挂着的地图，柔和的光线
Setting Description.en: Early morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, bedroom, quiet atmosphere, bed, desk, map hanging on the wall, soft lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 康塞尔站在床边，微微弯腰，表情关切，阿龙纳斯教授坐在床上，微笑回应
Static Shot Description.en: Conseil stands by the bed, slightly bending forward with a concerned expression. Professor Aronnax sits on the bed, smiling in response.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 加拿大人尼德·兰还在熟睡。
Plot Correspondence.en: The Canadian, Ned Land, is still sound asleep.

Setting Description.ch: 清晨，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，另一间卧室，安静的氛围，床铺、简单的家具、墙上挂着的渔网，昏暗的光线
Setting Description.en: Early morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, another bedroom, quiet atmosphere, bed, simple furniture, fishing net hanging on the wall, dim lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 尼德·兰躺在床上，鼾声如雷，表情安详，一只手臂搭在床边
Static Shot Description.en: Ned Land lies on the bed, snoring loudly with a peaceful expression. One arm rests on the side of the bed.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 我穿好由贝类纤维制成的衣服，这种材料既柔软又保暖。
Plot Correspondence.en: I dressed in clothes made of shellfish fiber, a material that is both soft and warm.

Setting Description.ch: 清晨，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，卧室，安静的氛围，衣柜、镜子、书桌，柔和的光线
Setting Description.en: Early morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, bedroom, quiet atmosphere, wardrobe, mirror, desk, soft lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿龙纳斯教授站在镜子前，正在扣上衣服的最后一颗扣子，表情满意，衣服材质显得柔软有光泽
Static Shot Description.en: Professor Aronnax stands in front of the mirror, fastening the last button of his clothes with a satisfied expression. The fabric appears soft and glossy.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 我去客厅等待尼摩船长，但他没有出现。
Plot Correspondence.en: I went to the lounge to wait for Captain Nemo, but he did not appear.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，客厅，豪华的装饰，沙发、茶几、墙上挂着的海洋画作，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, lounge, luxurious decor, sofa, coffee table, ocean-themed paintings on the wall, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿龙纳斯教授坐在沙发上，手中拿着一本书，表情期待，不时看向门口
Static Shot Description.en: Professor Aronnax sits on the sofa, holding a book with an expectant expression, occasionally glancing toward the door.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 我研究了柜子里的贝类和植物标本，但船长仍未露面。
Plot Correspondence.en: I examined the shell and plant specimens in the cabinet, but the captain still did not show up.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，客厅，豪华的装饰，展示柜、沙发、茶几，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, lounge, luxurious decor, display cabinet, sofa, coffee table, bright lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿龙纳斯教授站在展示柜前，仔细观察贝类标本，表情专注，一只手轻轻触摸标本
Static Shot Description.en: Professor Aronnax stands in front of the display cabinet, carefully observing shell specimens with a focused expression. One hand lightly touches a specimen.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 十一月十日，依然没有见到船长。我和康塞尔、尼德·兰都很疑惑。
Plot Correspondence.en: On November 10th, we still hadn't seen the captain. Conseil, Ned Land, and I were all puzzled.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，餐厅，简洁的装饰，餐桌、椅子、墙上挂着的航海图，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, dining room, simple decor, dining table, chairs, nautical chart on the wall, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 三人围坐在餐桌旁，表情疑惑，康塞尔微微皱眉，尼德·兰双手交叉放在胸前
Static Shot Description.en: The three sit around the dining table with puzzled expressions. Conseil frowns slightly, while Ned Land crosses his arms.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 我们享受着船上的自由和美食，但船长的缺席令人不安。
Plot Correspondence.en: We enjoyed the freedom and food on the ship, but the captain's absence was unsettling.

Setting Description.ch: 中午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，餐厅，简洁的装饰，餐桌上摆满美食、餐具、墙上挂着的航海图，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Noon, inside the Nautilus submarine, dining room, simple decor, dining table laden with food, tableware, nautical chart on the wall, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 三人正在用餐，阿龙纳斯教授若有所思，康塞尔细嚼慢咽，尼德·兰大口吃肉
Static Shot Description.en: The three are eating. Professor Aronnax looks thoughtful, Conseil chews slowly, and Ned Land eats meat heartily.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 十一月十一日，我在平台上呼吸新鲜空气，看到船副用望远镜观察四周。
Plot Correspondence.en: On November 11th, I stepped onto the platform to breathe fresh air and saw the first mate using binoculars to observe the surroundings.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇外部，平台，广阔的海洋，栏杆、船副、望远镜、远处的海平线，清新的海风
Setting Description.en: Morning, outside the Nautilus submarine, platform, vast ocean, railing, first mate, binoculars, distant horizon, fresh sea breeze

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿龙纳斯教授站在平台中央，深呼吸，表情放松，船副站在一旁，用望远镜观察四周
Static Shot Description.en: Professor Aronnax stands in the center of the platform, taking a deep breath with a relaxed expression. The first mate stands nearby, using binoculars to observe the surroundings.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 船副说了一句奇怪的话：“诺土隆一雷斯扑一罗宜一维尔希。”我不明白这句话的意思。
Plot Correspondence.en: The first mate said a strange phrase: 'Nautron respoc lorni virch.' I didn't understand its meaning.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇外部，平台，广阔的海洋，栏杆、船副、望远镜、远处的海平线，清新的海风
Setting Description.en: Morning, outside the Nautilus submarine, platform, vast ocean, railing, first mate, binoculars, distant horizon, fresh sea breeze

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 船副放下望远镜，表情严肃，说出那句奇怪的话，阿龙纳斯教授站在一旁，表情困惑
Static Shot Description.en: The first mate lowers the binoculars with a serious expression and utters the strange phrase. Professor Aronnax stands nearby, looking confused.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 接下来的五天，情况依旧，船长没有出现。
Plot Correspondence.en: For the next five days, the situation remained unchanged—the captain did not appear.

Setting Description.ch: 下午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，走廊，安静的氛围，墙上的舷窗、地板上的阴影、远处的舱门，昏暗的光线
Setting Description.en: Afternoon, inside the Nautilus submarine, corridor, quiet atmosphere, portholes on the wall, shadows on the floor, distant cabin door, dim lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 空无一人的走廊，光线透过舷窗洒在地板上，形成斑驳的阴影
Static Shot Description.en: The empty corridor has light streaming through the portholes, casting mottled shadows on the floor.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 十一月十六日，我收到船长的信，邀请我和同伴们去克利斯波岛的森林打猎。
Plot Correspondence.en: On November 16th, I received a letter from the captain inviting my companions and me to hunt in the forests of Crespo Island.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，客厅，豪华的装饰，茶几上放着一封信、沙发、墙上挂着的海洋画作，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, lounge, luxurious decor, letter on the coffee table, sofa, ocean-themed painting on the wall, bright lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿龙纳斯教授坐在沙发上，手中拿着船长的信，表情惊讶，信封上印有船长的徽章
Static Shot Description.en: Professor Aronnax sits on the sofa, holding the captain's letter with a surprised expression. The envelope bears the captain's emblem.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 我们都很惊讶，因为船长一直讨厌陆地。我查看地图，发现克利斯波岛是一个荒凉的小岛。
Plot Correspondence.en: We were all surprised because the captain had always despised land. I checked the map and found that Crespo Island was a desolate islet.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，客厅，豪华的装饰，茶几上放着一封信、沙发、墙上挂着的海洋画作、地图桌，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, lounge, luxurious decor, letter on the coffee table, sofa, ocean-themed painting on the wall, map table, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 三人围在地图桌旁，阿龙纳斯教授手指着地图上的克利斯波岛，表情疑惑，康塞尔和尼德·兰凑近观看
Static Shot Description.en: The three gather around the map table. Professor Aronnax points to Crespo Island on the map with a puzzled expression. Conseil and Ned Land lean in to look.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 十一月十七日，我见到了船长，他解释说我们要去的是海底森林，而不是陆地森林。
Plot Correspondence.en: On November 17th, I met the captain, who explained that we were going to an underwater forest, not a land forest.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，船长室，简洁而威严的装饰，书桌、椅子、墙上挂着的航海图，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, captain's quarters, simple yet imposing decor, desk, chair, nautical chart on the wall, bright lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 尼摩船长坐在书桌后，表情冷峻，阿龙纳斯教授站在桌前，表情惊讶
Static Shot Description.en: Captain Nemo sits behind the desk with a stern expression. Professor Aronnax stands in front of the desk, looking surprised.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 他展示了一套潜水设备，包括卢格罗尔呼吸器和兰可夫探照灯，这些设备能让我们在海底自由行动和照明。
Plot Correspondence.en: He displayed a set of diving equipment, including the Rouquayrol breathing apparatus and Ruhmkorff lamps, which would allow us to move and illuminate freely underwater.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，船长室，简洁而威严的装饰，书桌上放着潜水设备、墙上挂着的航海图，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, captain's quarters, simple yet imposing decor, diving equipment on the desk, nautical chart on the wall, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 尼摩船长站在书桌旁，手中拿着卢格罗尔呼吸器，表情自豪，设备细节清晰可见
Static Shot Description.en: Captain Nemo stands by the desk, holding the Rouquayrol breathing apparatus with a proud expression. The equipment's details are clearly visible.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 他还介绍了一种特殊的猎枪，使用压缩空气和高压玻璃球作为子弹，威力巨大。
Plot Correspondence.en: He also introduced a special hunting gun that used compressed air and high-pressure glass bullets, which were immensely powerful.

Setting Description.ch: 上午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，船长室，简洁而威严的装饰，书桌上放着猎枪、墙上挂着的航海图，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Morning, inside the Nautilus submarine, captain's quarters, simple yet imposing decor, hunting gun on the desk, nautical chart on the wall, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 尼摩船长手中拿着猎枪，枪身细节特写，表情严肃，手指轻轻抚过枪身
Static Shot Description.en: Captain Nemo holds the hunting gun with a serious expression. The gun's details are shown in close-up as he lightly runs his fingers over it.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 我和同伴们穿上潜水服，准备开始这次奇特的海底狩猎之旅。
Plot Correspondence.en: My companions and I put on diving suits, preparing for this peculiar underwater hunting expedition.

Setting Description.ch: 下午，诺第留斯号潜艇内部，准备室，简洁的装饰，潜水服、设备架、墙上挂着的操作指南，明亮的光线
Setting Description.en: Afternoon, inside the Nautilus submarine, preparation room, simple decor, diving suits, equipment rack, operational guide on the wall, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 三人正在穿戴潜水服，阿龙纳斯教授调整呼吸器，康塞尔检查探照灯，尼德·兰拿起猎枪，表情期待
Static Shot Description.en: The three are putting on diving suits. Professor Aronnax adjusts the breathing apparatus, Conseil checks the lamp, and Ned Land picks up the hunting gun with an eager expression.
